actions: Loaded latest main, repository instructions, watchdog lease, continuation state, Candidate index, native Store, Engine, and strict external claim path.
Recovered the stale single-execution lease from latest main and recorded the current platform-verified model.
Implemented a thin self-application recorder and CLI that serialize task-chat outcomes into native O state.
Added context-boundary selection for ordinary development, contamination-triggered logical reset, fresh retention/transfer validation, and fresh independent evaluation.
Added idempotent invocation journaling, inactive exact-scope Candidate generation, hidden-reasoning and secret-like-content rejection, and hard internal-evidence claim boundaries.
Superseded an initially passing head after safety review found permissive string-to-boolean flags and possible collision with existing native Run state.
Added package-level fail-closed guards for strict booleans, safe identifiers, and existing Run, Episode, or evidence collisions before mutation.
Rebased the final branch onto the latest watchdog heartbeat, passed exact-head CI, and merged PR 143.

claims.text: O repository development can now be persisted as native Run, Episode, optional inactive scoped Candidate, invocation journal, and internal evidence.
The public self-application boundary fails closed on malformed context flags, unsafe identifiers, hidden reasoning fields, secret-like content, and collisions with existing native state.
This task-chat record is internal development evidence only and does not establish AGI or evaluator independence.

decisions: Use repository latest main as the only durable continuation source and perform a logical reset because the inherited lease was stale.
Keep physical fresh context optional for ordinary development, but make contamination-sensitive validation boundaries explicit and enforceable.
Treat this work unit as PASS for self-application integration only; do not relabel it as AGI.
Keep the reusable context-hygiene instruction as an inactive Candidate limited to agi/repository-development until exact-scope evaluation and regression accept it.
Reject the initially CI-passing implementation head rather than merge after review exposed fail-open edge cases.
Preserve the strict external claim path, which consumes only an explicitly supplied clean signed external ledger and verifier registry.

executor.role: O semantic execution, implementation, falsification, and validation stage

failures.finding: String values such as false could be coerced truthy for context flags, and an explicitly reused native Run identifier could be overwritten.
failures.resolution: Superseded the head, added fail-closed public guards and adversarial tests, then required new exact-head CI.

objective: Integrate repository development as a native O execution and learning target, persist this task-chat work unit as O-compatible durable state, and continue AGI development without weakening the independent external evidence gate.
observations: PR 142 had already merged a machine-readable external evaluation request bound to the strict independent evidence gate.
The existing Run, Episode, Candidate, Store, and invocation formats were flexible enough to accept a thin task-chat execution adapter without replacing the Engine.

success_conditions: A minimal native adapter writes Run, Episode, invocation journal, fragments, optional scoped Candidate, and internal evidence.
Ordinary development may reuse context only without contamination signals; selected reset, fresh, or independent boundaries are enforced before PASS.
Malformed booleans, unsafe identifiers, hidden reasoning fields, secret-like material, and native-state collisions fail closed before durable mutation.
Self-produced evidence remains internal development evidence and is never admissible for the strict external AGI claim gate.
The exact guarded PR head passes the full repository CI and merges unchanged.
